name: FormulationLab DGEBA/4,4'-DDS dual-mode Tg Bayesian optimizer
origin: Adapted from Nannan's original DGEBA/PGE/EDA Gaussian Process notebook

modes.conversion: Select next real, verified, pre-crosslinked DGEBA/DDS structure from the manifest; ratio fixed per campaign
modes.composition: Propose integer DGEBA and DDS counts and desired conversion; produce network-generation request, not an existing network

physics.conversion_definition: epoxides reacted / starting epoxide groups; count actual reactions and compare network connectivity; not a placeholder target
physics.conversion_limit_note: If ratio < 1, epoxy conversion cannot exceed the available reactive amine-H fraction, assuming only ideal epoxy-amine reactions; not a guarantee of network gelation
physics.force_field: Livraghi block chemistry, AMBER conventions (lj/cut/coul/long; special_bonds amber), not the D230 CHARMM setup
physics.structure_source: Published Livraghi DGEBA/DDS uncured 100:50 configuration 1, Carbono pilot; no cured 90% output available in this package

policies.exploration_when_few_results: greedy distance-based initial design; no GP predictions
policies.GP_activation: at least 4 distinct approved feature configurations, exploratory only
policies.duplicate_rule: do not repeat completed/in-flight candidate; in conversion mode avoid repeated conversion levels
policies.cooling_rate_effect: all Tg results must retain protocol and temperature units; do not mix inconsistent fidelities
